description: Manage outbound records, lists, sequences, and follow-up tasks in Unify.

unify_new_list_trigger.description: Runs for each new list in Unify. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unify_new_or_updated_list_trigger.description: Runs for each new or updated list in Unify. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unify_new_or_updated_task_trigger.description: Runs for each new or updated task in Unify. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unify_new_task_trigger.description: Runs for each new task in Unify. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
